title: Identity Management Incident Response
description: Identity management system incidents affecting aerospace access and security
immediate_actions: Assess impact on aerospace operations and security
Contact security team for access impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review identity management system logs and status
Verify network connectivity to identity systems
resolution_steps: Restart identity management services following standard procedures
Implement authentication service fixes if needed
Apply identity system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with identity vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with aerospace staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Identity management is critical for aerospace security
Do not transfer restricted data to non-approved systems
Coordinate with security team for minimal disruption to operations
